content_text:
Permanent Full-Time | Wodonga Office
About the Company
JCA Land Consultants is a leading Surveying and Engineering Consultancy with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality outcomes across Victoria. With continued growth across our Ringwood and Wodonga offices, we are looking for a motivated and talented Graduate Design Engineer  for our Wodonga Office
What We Offer
At JCA, we believe in supporting our people as much as our projects. You’ll enjoy:
·        Exposure to a diverse range of projects – Commercial, Industrial, and Residential developments.
·        Career advancement opportunities within a respected and growing consultancy.
·        A collaborative, supportive, and positive workplace culture where your voice matters.
·        The chance to make a real impact in your community.
·        Attractive salary packages.
The Role
The Graduate positions will involve design, documentation, and construction review across a wide variety of projects, including:
·        Residential, Industrial, and Commercial developments
·        Local Government and Department of Transport infrastructure projects
·        Water Authority assets and Residential Body Corporate developments
About You
To be successful in these roles, you will ideally have:
·        A Degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent qualification)
·        Exposure to 12D (preferred) and AutoCAD software (preferred)
·        Knowledge of Local Authority Standards – Councils, North East Water, and Department of Transport
·        Understanding of Quality Assurance processes
·        Strong Communication Skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment
Please include the SUBURB in which you reside as part of your application.
Apply now.
